## Success Plan (First 90 Days)

### Month 1: Onboarding & Activation
**Goal:** Get team set up and first value moment

| Week | Activity | Owner | Success Criteria |
|------|----------|-------|------------------|
| Week 1 | Kickoff call, account setup | CSM | Account created, admin invited |
| Week 2 | User onboarding, first assessment | Customer | 50% users complete assessment |
| Week 3 | Team Map view, insights review | CSM | Team viewed, insights discussed |
| Week 4 | First playbook, value check-in | CSM | 1 playbook completed, value confirmed |

### Month 2: Adoption & Engagement
**Goal:** Drive regular usage and feature adoption

| Week | Activity | Owner | Success Criteria |
|------|----------|-------|------------------|
| Week 5 | Slack integration setup | CSM | Slack connected, notifications enabled |
| Week 6 | Advanced features training | CSM | Team trained on advanced features |
| Week 7 | First conflict alert (if applicable) | Customer | Alert viewed, action taken |
| Week 8 | Mid-point check-in | CSM | Satisfaction survey, feedback collected |

### Month 3: Value Realization & Expansion
**Goal:** Prove ROI and identify expansion opportunities

| Week | Activity | Owner | Success Criteria |
|------|----------|-------|------------------|
| Week 9 | ROI analysis | CSM | ROI calculated, shared with customer |
| Week 10 | Expansion discussion | CSM | Identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities |
| Week 11 | QBR preparation | CSM | QBR deck drafted |
| Week 12 | QBR meeting | CSM + Customer | QBR conducted, renewal discussed |
